Your ride yesterday from Mission to SoMa was $31.40 because there was **50% prime time pricing** in effect. That means demand was high at that time, so the base fare was increased by 50%.

The charge was just the fare—no additional fees or tolls. Prime time pricing adjusts based on rider demand in your area, so prices can vary depending on when you ride. That's why it was higher than your usual $20 trips.

Does that help explain it?
